spans.s:
áṃśa, m. (that which one gets, i. e.) one's
portion; and so, generalized, portion, part.
[√1aś, ‘get.’]

áṃsa, m. shoulder. [perhaps, ‘the strong’
(part), √am, 1197a: cf. ὦμ-ος, Lat. um-erus,
Goth. amsa, ‘shoulder.’]

aṃśú, m. juicy internodium or shoot of the
Soma-plant; and so, shooting ray (of
light).

aṃśumánt, a. rich in beams, radiant; as
m. the sun, 16^4. [aṃśú, 1235b.]
